title: Coconut Pupusas
description: A venezuelan-inspired dish with a warm twist, featuring chewy pupusas stuffed with coconut and pasta.
instructions: Combine masa harina and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the pasta mixture onto the center of each disk.
Top with shredded coconut and chopped cilantro.
Fold the dough over to form a half-circle, pressing the edges together to seal.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the pupusas for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve warm with coconut milk for dipping.
